sections.summary: Most rendering methods now include a MatrixStack in their parameters. GUIs are an exception in which some methods still use old RenderSystem and GlStateManager calls.

sections.summary: These are now a static builder function you call during FMLClientSetupEvent. Use ItemProperties#register. The supplier in that method takes a LivingEntity, ClientWorld and ItemStack.

sections.title: Reload Listener Registration
